title: Frappe ERPNext 15.55.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.55.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or those without assigned roles, to access the Chart of Accounts of any company by sending crafted requests without proper permission checks.
